nodes.name: components.json
nodes.summary: shadcn/ui component registry configuration for the Tauri app shell, specifying the base-nova style, Tailwind CSS integration with cssVariables, lucide icon library, and path aliases for components, utils, ui, lib, and hooks.

nodes.name: index.html
nodes.summary: HTML entry point for the Vite-bundled Waggle app shell, mounting the React app into the #root div and loading the main.tsx module entry point with the Waggle logo favicon.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Package manifest for the waggle-app Tauri desktop shell, defining build scripts for cross-platform Tauri binaries (Windows, macOS, debug/release), code signing workflows, and runtime dependencies including React 19, Tauri v2 APIs, and Tailwind 4.
nodes.languageNotes: The tauri:build scripts chain sidecar bundling, native dep bundling, and Vite build for apps/web before invoking tauri build — this reflects the multi-stage desktop packaging pipeline.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript compiler configuration for the Tauri shell's build/installer/signing scripts under app/scripts/, enabling strict mode, bundler module resolution, React JSX, and the @/* path alias — intentionally excludes app/src-tauri (Rust) since the React UI now lives in apps/web.
nodes.languageNotes: The include array targets only the scripts/ subdirectory, not src/, because the React cockpit UI was migrated to apps/web; this tsconfig serves as a type-gate for the Tauri build/signing tooling only.
